title: Brief special meeting authorizes closed session
subtitle: Closed session to cover land disposition, land acquisition, and legal matters; no delegations or mayoral business
overview: Kitchener City Council held a short special meeting on May 5, 2025. The Mayor opened with a land acknowledgement. No councillors declared a pecuniary interest, no delegations were registered, and the Mayor had no business or updates to report.

The only substantive action was a vote to hold a closed (in-camera) session immediately afterward {{vote:m1}}. The minutes list three matters: a potential land disposition and a solicitor-client privilege matter, a potential land acquisition, and a solicitor-client privilege and litigation or potential litigation matter along with a potential land disposition. The session was authorized under sections of the Municipal Act, 2001 that allow councils to meet privately on property and legal issues.
For residents, no public decisions were made at this meeting. Any resulting decisions would need to come back to a public meeting. The meeting adjourned at 4:31 p.m., about a minute after it began.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to meet in camera right after the special meeting to consider land disposition, land acquisition, and solicitor-client privilege and litigation or potential litigation matters under the Municipal Act, 2001 {{vote:m1}}.
